# Spencer Allen

> Personal website, blog, and developer portfolio for Spencer Allen.

Student, developer, and tech enthusiast based in Brisbane, Australia. 

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://spencerallen.me/): Spencer Allen's portfolio landing page.
- [About](https://spencerallen.me/about/): Personal background, bio, and interests.
- [Tech](https://spencerallen.me/tech/): Technology projects, coding, and web applications.
- [Games](https://spencerallen.me/games/): Interactive web games and gaming projects.
- [Blog](https://spencerallen.me/blog/): Articles, blog posts, and tech write-ups.
- [Hosting](https://spencerallen.me/hosting/): Home server game hosting capabilities, specs, and supported dedicated servers.

## Social & Links
